name: Faithfulness
one_line: Proportion of generated claims entailed by the retrieved chunks.

formula.notation: F(a) = |{ claims in a entailed by context }| / |claims in a|

terms.meaning: atomic assertions extracted from the answer
judged by an LLM against a published rubric, not string match

range.note: Mathematical range. No typical value is stated: it would be a number with no run behind it.

ci.why: A point estimate over a few hundred queries without an interval is the first thing a reviewer attacks.
